title: Three Weeks and One Short Needle
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：T-shirt　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 T-shirt 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the tailor ① wore the T-shirt that no customer in the shop would have described, and he said the wearing was the whole of the week. The ② T-shirt, meaning the shirt itself and not the needle, ran three weeks and stayed undescribed in the book; a T-shirt, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ T-shirt in that shop had the same short needle beside it, and the ④ T-shirt at the far mirror, meaning the collar they kept for the children to mend and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A T-shirt, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the tailor said the describing is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the T-shirt was the whole of the matter, meaning the ease and not the shirt. The ⑥ T-shirt, meaning the ease and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; T-shirt, he said, is either something you wear or the only word that means both a shirt and an ease. He said the ease is the part they remember.

By 1982 the ⑦ T-shirt had become a line in an order, and the order had become an argument about the short needle. The ⑧ T-shirt of the whole thing, the tailor wrote in November, was one shop and three weeks of describing; T-shirt, he said, is either the collar at the far mirror or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The  T-shirt I remember is the shirt described in the order, which closed in 1984 and is still described as the quietest in the shop. A  T-shirt, my mother said in 1986, is the only shirt that improves by being described; every T-shirt, she said, is an ease that has agreed to look like a shirt. She said the ease was the honest half.

answers.why: wear the T-shirt 意为“穿这一件T恤衫”，1977 年那位裁缝把裁缝铺里没有一位顾客肯描述的一件T恤衫做了一遍。
T-shirt 意为“T恤衫”，指那件T恤衫本身而不是细细的针，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被描述。
T-shirt 意为“T恤衫”，指裁缝铺里每一件旁边的那一件，每一件旁边都有同一枚细细的针。
T-shirt 意为“T恤衫”，指最远那面试衣镜的留给孩子们补的那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
T-shirt 意为“T恤衫、自在”，指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这件自在就是那件事的全部。
T-shirt 意为“自在”，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西而不是那件T恤衫，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
T-shirt 意为“T恤衫”，指订单簿里写到、被描述的那一件，到 1982 年这一件成了订单簿里的一行。
T-shirt 意为“T恤衫之事”，裁缝十一月写道，整件事的T恤衫之事是一处裁缝铺和三个星期的描述。
